title: Encryption of Personal Data Storage
description: Personal data storage should use encryption as an appropriate technical measure.
subject: personal_data_storage
verification_notes: The framework checks the infrastructure configuration to see whether encryption is enabled for the storage resource. The policy passes when encryption is enabled.
message: Personal data storage does not have encryption enabled.

title: Private by Default Storage
description: Storage containing personal data should not be publicly accessible by default.
subject: personal_data_storage
verification_notes: The framework checks whether the storage resource allows public access. The policy passes when public access is disabled.
message: Personal data storage is publicly accessible.

title: Access Control for Personal Data
description: Systems processing personal data should maintain confidentiality through access control.
subject: personal_data_storage
verification_notes: The framework checks whether an access-control mechanism is enabled for the storage resource. This helps prevent unauthorised users from accessing personal data.
message: Access control is not enabled for the resource containing personal data.

title: TLS for Network Endpoints
description: Network endpoints handling personal data should protect confidentiality in transit.
subject: network_endpoint
verification_notes: The framework checks whether TLS is enabled on network endpoints that send or receive personal data. TLS encrypts the data while it travels across a network.
message: TLS is not enabled on a network endpoint handling personal data.

title: Audit Logging for Breach Documentation
description: Systems should maintain logs to support breach documentation and investigation.
subject: processing_system
verification_notes: The framework checks whether logging is enabled for the processing system. Logs provide evidence that can be used to investigate incidents and document personal-data breaches.
message: Audit logging is not enabled for the processing system.

title: Backup and Restoration
description: Personal data should be restorable after a physical or technical incident.
subject: personal_data_storage
verification_notes: The framework checks whether backups are enabled for storage containing personal data. Backups allow the organisation to restore data after loss, damage or a system failure.
message: Backups are not enabled for the storage resource.

title: Processing System Resilience
description: Processing systems should maintain resilience through redundant instances.
subject: processing_system
verification_notes: The framework checks the number of running replicas and compares it with the required minimum of two. Multiple replicas allow another instance to continue operating if one instance fails.
message: The processing system has fewer than two replicas.

title: Storage Limitation
description: Personal data should not be retained for longer than necessary.
subject: personal_data_storage
verification_notes: The framework checks whether the configured retention period is no more than 365 days. This is partially automatable because the framework can check the number of days, but it cannot determine whether 365 days is appropriate for the organisation's actual processing purpose.
message: Personal data is configured to be retained for more than 365 days.

title: Data Integrity Versioning
description: Storage systems should support integrity by enabling versioning where appropriate.
subject: personal_data_storage
verification_notes: The framework checks whether versioning is enabled for the storage resource. Versioning keeps earlier copies of data, which can help recover information that has been changed or deleted.
message: Versioning is not enabled for the storage resource.

title: Security Monitoring
description: Security controls should be monitored and evaluated regularly.
subject: processing_system
verification_notes: The framework checks whether a monitoring service is enabled for the processing system. This is partially automatable because the configuration can show that monitoring exists, but it cannot prove that alerts are reviewed or that security controls are tested regularly.
message: Security monitoring is not enabled for the processing system.

title: Health Checks for Availability
description: Processing systems should use health checks to support availability and resilience.
subject: processing_system
verification_notes: The framework checks whether health checks are enabled for the processing system. Health checks detect failed or unhealthy instances so that they can be restarted or replaced.
message: Health checks are not enabled for the processing system.

title: Multi-AZ Resilience
description: Critical processing systems should support resilience through multi-availability-zone deployment.
subject: processing_system
verification_notes: The framework checks whether the processing system is deployed across more than one availability zone. This reduces the likelihood that a failure in one location makes the entire system unavailable.
message: Multi-availability-zone deployment is not enabled for the critical processing system.

title: Secret Management
description: Secrets used by systems processing personal data should not be stored in plaintext.
subject: processing_system
verification_notes: The framework checks the infrastructure configuration for values that appear to contain plaintext passwords, tokens or keys. This is partially automatable because some secrets may not be recognised from their names or may exist outside the Terraform configuration.
message: A plaintext secret was detected in the infrastructure configuration.

title: Data Protection by Default
description: Systems should ensure that personal data is not accessible by default to an indefinite number of people.
subject: personal_data_storage
verification_notes: The framework checks whether storage containing personal data is configured as private when it is created. The policy passes when users must be explicitly authorised before they can access the data.
message: The resource containing personal data is not private by default.

title: Recovery Configuration
description: Systems should support timely recovery of access to personal data following an incident.
subject: processing_system
verification_notes: The framework checks whether a recovery mechanism is configured for the processing system. This is partially automatable because the configuration may show that recovery features exist, but it cannot prove that the organisation can recover within an acceptable amount of time.
message: Recovery configuration is not enabled for the processing system.

title: Encryption of Personal Data Backups
description: Backups containing personal data should be encrypted to protect the data if the backup is lost, stolen or accessed without authorisation.
subject: personal_data_backup
verification_notes: This policy checks whether backup storage has encryption enabled. It is fully automatable because this setting can usually be identified directly from the infrastructure configuration.
message: Backup encryption is not enabled.

title: Encryption Key Rotation
description: Encryption keys protecting personal data should be rotated regularly to reduce the impact of a compromised key.
subject: encryption_key
verification_notes: This policy checks whether automatic key rotation is enabled. If key rotation is disabled, the same encryption key may be used for a long time, increasing security risk.
message: Encryption key rotation is disabled.

title: Encryption Key Separation
description: Encryption keys should be stored separately from the personal data they protect to reduce the impact of a security breach.
subject: encryption_key
verification_notes: The framework can identify where encryption keys are referenced, but it cannot always determine how an organisation manages those keys. Additional evidence may be required.
message: The framework could not confirm that encryption keys are stored separately from the data.

title: Security Log Retention
description: Security logs should be retained for a suitable period so that security incidents can be investigated.
subject: security_logs
verification_notes: The framework compares the configured log retention period against the required minimum of 90 days.
message: Security logs are not retained for long enough.

title: Protection Against Log Modification
description: Security logs should be protected so they cannot be modified or deleted by unauthorised users.
subject: security_logs
verification_notes: The framework checks whether immutable logging or deletion protection has been enabled. This helps preserve evidence after a security incident.
message: Security logs are not protected from modification.

title: Restriction of Public Administrative Access
description: Administrative interfaces should not be accessible from the public Internet unless there is a justified and secure reason.
subject: administrative_interface
verification_notes: The framework checks firewall rules, public IP addresses and security groups to determine whether administrator interfaces are exposed to the Internet.
message: Administrative interfaces are publicly accessible.

title: Network Traffic Restriction
description: Systems processing personal data should only allow the network traffic that is necessary for their operation.
subject: processing_system
verification_notes: The framework checks for unrestricted inbound firewall rules such as 0.0.0.0/0. These rules expose services to anyone on the Internet.
message: Unrestricted inbound network access has been detected.

title: Multi-Factor Authentication for Privileged Access
description: Privileged accounts should use multi-factor authentication to reduce the risk of unauthorised administrative access.
subject: privileged_user
verification_notes: The framework checks whether multi-factor authentication is configured for privileged access. It is only partially automatable because the infrastructure may show that MFA is available, but it may not prove that every administrator has enrolled and actively uses it.
message: Multi-factor authentication for privileged accounts could not be fully confirmed.

title: Least-Privilege Access
description: Users and services should only have the permissions required to perform their authorised responsibilities.
subject: system_identity
verification_notes: The framework can identify obviously excessive permissions, such as administrator access or wildcard permissions. However, it cannot always determine the exact permissions each user or service genuinely needs.
message: Least-privilege access could not be fully confirmed.

title: Combined Security Controls
description: Systems processing personal data should use several security controls together, including encryption, access control, logging and backups.
subject: processing_system
verification_notes: This policy checks several controls at the same time instead of checking one setting. It only passes when encryption, access control, logging and backups are all present and compliant.
message: One or more required security controls are missing.

title: Data Protection Impact Assessment
description: A Data Protection Impact Assessment should be completed before beginning processing that is likely to create a high risk to individuals.
subject: processing_activity
verification_notes: The framework can use supplied risk information to identify when a DPIA may be required. However, Terraform cannot prove that the assessment document exists, has been completed correctly or has been approved.
message: A completed Data Protection Impact Assessment could not be confirmed.

title: Restriction of Public Database Access
description: Databases containing personal data should not be directly reachable from the public Internet.
subject: personal_data_database
verification_notes: The framework checks the database instance's public-accessibility setting. The policy passes when the database cannot be reached directly from the public Internet.
message: The database instance is configured to be publicly accessible.

title: Encryption of Database Storage
description: Personal data stored in a database should be encrypted at rest as an appropriate technical measure.
subject: personal_data_database
verification_notes: The framework checks whether the database instance has storage encryption enabled.
message: The database instance does not have storage encryption enabled.

title: Database Backup Retention
description: Databases containing personal data should have automated backups configured so data can be restored after an incident.
subject: personal_data_database
verification_notes: The framework checks whether the database instance's automated backup retention period is greater than zero days.
message: The database instance does not have automated backups configured.

title: Database Multi-AZ Resilience
description: Databases containing personal data should be deployed across multiple availability zones to support resilience.
subject: personal_data_database
verification_notes: The framework checks whether the database instance is configured for multi-availability-zone deployment.
message: The database instance is not deployed across multiple availability zones.
